sentences.en: Taking residential high-rise buildings as an example, this article gives 90/70 floorage middle and small residence design schemes so as to satisfy the requirements for saving land resources.

sentences.en: Contents : The project covers an area of 93 mu, with a total floorage of 52140 square meters. It is to purchase 269 sets of production facility, designing and testing equipment.
